profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary: Embedded software engineer with an interest in complex, multi-disciplinary projects.

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
-Led a large-scale redesign of an edge-learning image processing tool, including customer-facing API (C++17) and UI design (WPF).
-Contributed to the development, testing, and release of four major software versions.
-Wrote unit and system level tests (C++/C#) to expand testing coverage as part of CI infrastructure. 
-Gained experience in aspects of 2D image processing, such as linear transforms, mapping between coordinate spaces, and affine transformations.
-Participated as a member of an Agile scrum team, including daily standups, bi-weekly planning, refinement, and retrospective sessions, and code reviews of other teammates.

positions.title: Electrical Test Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
-Co-op from June 2020 to January 2021, Part time from January 2021 to June 2021.
-Performed testing and troubleshooting of analog and embedded digital circuit cards using oscilloscopes, DMMs, and I-V curve tracers.
-Analyzed monthly production test data to measure current performance against past performance and developed a database of historical data to reference.
-Conducted initial testing of a new CCA, involving signal integrity analysis of I2C and FPGA Serial Buffer Interface failure modes, resulting in a new version of software that corrected these issues.
-Worked with design and test engineering to analyze a systemic JTAG Chain failure and designed a corrective action of terminating resistors on the lines of the JTAG select CPLD.

positions.title: Student Athlete Peer Tutor
positions.description:
-Assist student-athletes with classes, such as General Chemistry, Calculus I-II, etc. 
-Adapt to students as learners and create a productive and beneficial learning environment

projects.title: BlocTacToe
projects.description:
-Designed a VGA driver circuit in Simulink to model a Tic-Tac-Toe game board
-Implemented Object Oriented C++ for functionality and logic
-Utilized JTAG to program a Xilinx FPGA on a ZedBoard with onboard DIP switches and pushbuttons and a VGA connection to display the game on a computer monitor
